newsitem.title: UK: Unilever off on profit-taking, arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: Unilever off on profit-taking, arbitrage.

text.p: Shares in Unilever Plc tumbled on Friday amid profit-taking and arbitrage-related selling against the shares listed in Amsterdam, dealers said.
By 1432 GMT, shares in Unilever Plc were down 45-1/2p to 1581. Unilever NV shares were quoted at 361.50 Dutch guiders, down 9.20.
From February 7 to February 26, shares in Unilever Plc surged almost three pounds, or more than 21 percent, reaching an intraday peak of 1662p on February 26.
"The buying just dried up," said one market maker. He said that lack of fresh buyers prompted profit-taking, contributing to the wider spread between the shares listed in London and Amsterdam.
